aggregation.error: any incomplete/ambiguous population or stat/traversal error yields ERROR; no partial PASS
aggregation.value: VALUE uses <absent> for an allowed missing root, otherwise checked=N;violations=M
aggregation.violation: any included object with (mode & 0033) != 0 yields FAIL

comparison.bits-clear: parse observed mode as octal and require (observed_mode & expected_mask) == 0; for SRC-0010 expected_mask is exactly 0033

deterministic_enumeration: for a directory root, direct entries are sorted bytewise under LC_ALL=C before evaluation
directory_root_population: the root directory itself plus its direct regular-file children only
file_root_population: the root regular file itself only

missing_root_behavior.reason: SRC-0010 explicitly says listed system cron objects may not always be present

nested_directory_behavior.reason: source does not unambiguously authorize widening the population to recursive descendants; a nested directory therefore prevents a complete source-faithful decision

regular_file_child_behavior: included and checked; hard links are regular files and are evaluated as encountered directory entries
